# Sidegraph

> Durable decisions and non-derivable facts for coding agents, stored as repo-committed
> JSON records with a derived local index. Sidegraph reads Graphify's code/doc graph and
> delivers mistakes-first, task-scoped memory through MCP and Claude Code/Codex hooks.

Use [README.md](README.md) for task-oriented navigation. This index points to the guides
and exact contracts; it does not replace their version-specific requirements.

## Getting started

- [getting-started/installation.md](getting-started/installation.md) — installing Sidegraph and its Graphify dependency
- [getting-started/quickstart.md](getting-started/quickstart.md) — one end-to-end path: graph, store, host plugin, anchored gotcha, retrieval, commit
- [getting-started/bootstrap.md](getting-started/bootstrap.md) — preview, review, import, and prove retrieval from supported ADR/spec documents; host support and recovery
- [getting-started/claude-code-setup.md](getting-started/claude-code-setup.md) — wiring the MCP server and hooks into Claude Code
- [getting-started/codex-setup.md](getting-started/codex-setup.md) — wiring Sidegraph into Codex

## Guides

- [guides/migrating-to-0.14.md](guides/migrating-to-0.14.md) — coordinated client upgrade, domain snapshot, Graphify upgrade, verification and rollback

- [guides/health-check.md](guides/health-check.md) — the read-only installation health report: plugin wiring, versions, Graphify, store integrity
- [guides/adr-export.md](guides/adr-export.md) — exporting stored decisions as Markdown ADRs with `sidegraph-export-adr`
- [guides/capturing-decisions.md](guides/capturing-decisions.md) — human-requested capture, agent proposals, ratification policies, and attached or standalone facts
- [guides/naming-your-domains.md](guides/naming-your-domains.md) — conversational and CLI paths for naming domains; membership guardrails and recovery
- [guides/retrieval-in-sessions.md](guides/retrieval-in-sessions.md) — reading SessionStart and task-context output, evidence, and unratified proposals
- [guides/surviving-refactors.md](guides/surviving-refactors.md) — rebuilding the graph, syncing anchors, healing stale decisions
- [guides/troubleshooting.md](guides/troubleshooting.md) — session integrity checks, notices, diagnostic commands, and fixes
- [guides/team-workflow.md](guides/team-workflow.md) — committing the store, PR review, merge conflicts, compaction, and onboarding
- [guides/semantic-docs.md](guides/semantic-docs.md) — the two-pass (AST + LLM) workflow over docs, concept/rationale anchoring, and the sidegraph-import bootstrap walkthrough
- [guides/verifying-your-setup.md](guides/verifying-your-setup.md) — a four-case post-install checklist: host wiring, durable capture/retrieval, ratification with evidence, and sync/repository hygiene
- [guides/ci-cd-maintenance.md](guides/ci-cd-maintenance.md) — GitHub Actions recipes for anchor health, store lint, and scheduled triage; CI proposes and opens PRs without ratifying

## Reference

- [reference/mcp-tools.md](reference/mcp-tools.md) — MCP tool parameters, return shapes, write guards, and retrieval behavior
- [reference/cli.md](reference/cli.md) — command flags, output, exit codes, import profiles, verification, and local diagnostics
- [reference/hooks.md](reference/hooks.md) — sidegraph-session-start, sidegraph-stop, sidegraph-pre-tool-use, and sidegraph-subagent-start: env, JSON I/O, guarantees
- [reference/git-bindings.md](reference/git-bindings.md) — commit trailers (candidate rules, comment-char handling, fail-open bounded stages, installation) and sidegraph-blame (trailer + provenance joins and output caps)
- [reference/configuration.md](reference/configuration.md) — environment variables, store/graph paths, retrieval budgets, and sync caches
- [reference/stability.md](reference/stability.md) — committed and provisional surfaces, compatibility policy, and behavioral guarantees
- [reference/operations.md](reference/operations.md) — what runs when, local writes and measured costs, the graph boundary, CI wiring, and unmeasured scale questions
- [reference/store-format.md](reference/store-format.md) — canonical JSON layout, derived state, migrations, archives, append-only writes, and merges
- [reference/releasing.md](reference/releasing.md) — maintainer release preparation, public snapshots, tagging, publishing, and post-release checks

## Engineering whitepaper

- [published whitepaper](https://github.com/SantyagoSeaman/sidegraph/blob/main/docs/whitepaper/index.md) — optional evidence and limits, including the corpus where memory cost +25.5% and answered worse; repository fit and staged adoption gates
